title: Mountain-range marks for the flat maps: today's named ranges (Natural Earth) and, on each past PaleoDEM grid, the ranges found in its own heights
note: Natural Earth 10 m physical geography regions (version 5.0.0) carries 222 polygons of feature class Range/mtn with a scale rank (1 the largest) and names in several languages, Korean among them. scripts/build_mountain_ranges.py places marks along the crest of each range of rank 1 or 2 at the present, with heights from the present PaleoDEM grid; the past grids have no named ranges, so their marks come from each grid's own heights by the rule in the script. The PaleoDEM grids are those of sources/paleodem.json, found as scripts/build_paleodem.py finds them.
